transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because I can’t seem to keep my schoolwork and my little accessories shop organized at the same time. My supplies, due dates, receipts, and assignment notes just end up in piles, and then I don’t know what I’m supposed to do first.
How long have you been struggling with staying organized and keeping things in order?
About two years and two months. It really started when I changed schools and had to handle the business program and my accessories shop with a lot less structure.
Looking back to your childhood before age 12, did you have similar difficulties with organization or paying attention?

Yeah. My mom still has notes from elementary school saying I was always getting out of my seat, talking before I was called on, and rushing through group activities even when I understood what we were doing.
These days, do you still struggle with feeling restless or having a hard time sitting still?
Yeah, a lot. Even when I’m not going anywhere, it feels like my body is buzzing and I need to move, especially if I’m supposed to just sit still and listen.
